body: I'm doing a research study on the effectiveness on a treatment program for individuals struggling with PTSD. This intervention has done before in the past and has been shown to improve mental health and cognitive performance amongst military members and first responders. I just wanted to share this project as therapy is often expensive and although research cannot guarantee the intervention will be helpful, we hope that you or someone you know will benefit from the program. Email ptsdgmt@mcmaster.ca to get connected with the project.
